b.alt: UML class diagram: class Automobile at top with two filled diamonds on its bottom edge. From the left diamond a solid line runs to class Tire (bottom left), multiplicity 1 at the Automobile end and * at the Tire end. From the right diamond a solid line runs to class Engine (bottom right), multiplicity 1 at the Automobile end and * at the Engine end. Each class box has a name compartment and two empty compartments.
